messages:
katie: Quick alignment thread for the v0.9 launch tomorrow. Need: final changelog link, prod docs URL, hero stat for blog, and exact rollout timeline so we can schedule social + paid promos.
olivia: I have a draft hero: "25% lower token cost at 8k+ contexts vs previous release". Can eng confirm that phrasing? Also need a perf chart PNG from @ben for the blog hero.
rishi: That stat is fair based on our large-context evals, will confirm numbers and attach chart. We measured 24-27% median token cost drop on our L5 test suite.
aj: Docs staging is green: https://docs.redwood.inference.dev/staging/v0.9/ — I can flip to prod at 11:30 PT. Will update changelog anchor.
ben: Changelog draft pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/blob/main/v0.9.md — highlights: improved KV cache, ~30% p50 latency improvement on long sequences, new q4_x2 quant variant, opt-in X-Model-Version header, streaming reconnect fix.
ben: Dropping the perf PNG in this thread in 10m (will be named perf_8k_contexts_v0.9.png).
emma: On inbound routing: we'll use utm_campaign=v0_9_launch and route form fills to HubSpot list `sdr_v3`. Can marketing also add a pre-qualification hidden field so SDRs can triage?
olivia: Yes — we'll add hidden field `launch_channel=blog` + `utm_source=social` for promoted posts. Emma — can you confirm the HubSpot workflow name?
emma: Workflow: "V0.9 Launch - SDR Intake" — will create and auto-assign to SDR queue sdr_v3 and ping #sales when lead score > 30.
katie: Rollout ask for eng: proposed timeline? Also SLO thresholds for rollback/hold. Marketing wants embargo lift time to coordinate posts.
rishi: Proposed deploy: canary 10% at 09:00 PT -> observe 45m -> ramp 50% at 09:50 PT -> 100% by 12:00 PT if p95 latency stable. Canary alerts: error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency regression > 12% -> pause and rollback.
ben: Note: API change is opt-in this release (X-Model-Version). We'll add a migration note in the changelog and a short snippet for the blog: `If you pin model versions, add the new header to avoid implicit fallbacks.`
aj: I'll promote docs at 11:30 PT and post the prod link here. Please plan to reference /v0.9/changelog in the blog.
deploy-bot: docs-deploy scheduled -> promoting https://docs.redwood.inference.dev/staging/v0.9/ to prod at 2026-01-28T11:30:00Z
rishi: Also adding a short benchmark note for marketing: "Benchmarks on representative customer workloads show 25% lower token cost and median latency improvements on long prompts — details in the changelog."
olivia: Perfect. For the webinar: we set it for Feb 4, 11:00 PT. Landing page is live: https://go.redwood.ai/webinar-v0-9 — please confirm the CTA copy.
katie: CTA: "See v0.9 in action + live Q&A". Add UTM params utm_campaign=v0_9_launch&utm_source=webinar. Also need a speaker headshot from @rishi and @ben.
ben: Uploading speaker headshots now. Also uploading perf_8k_contexts_v0.9.png to the drive.
aj: Prod docs live: https://docs.redwood.inference.dev/v0.9/ — changelog at /v0.9/changelog.
katie: Great — marketing will schedule blog + tweet thread + LinkedIn at 12:15 PT (embargo lift 12:00 PT). Olivia will queue paid promos to start at 13:00 PT.
emma: HubSpot flow created. I've added the hidden pre-qual field and set notifications to AE on high-intent leads.
rishi: Final ask: marketing please use non-technical hero line and link to the changelog for technical details. Example hero: "Major cost and latency improvements for long-context LLM workloads."
olivia: We'll use that and link to changelog for the deep-dive. Katie — once you publish, drop the blog URL here so comms can update partners.
katie: Will do. Thanks team — please flag any roll timing changes here ASAP so we can hold promos. :rocket:
